fields.summary: Autonomous plan run with no owner; the arbiter answered the planner's questions. Cause found: Rhiza's workflows set GOTMPDIR={run_tmp}, which is <git common dir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/tmp, and go-internal testscript makes $WORK under $GOTMPDIR, so scripts that don't init their own repo reach ~/code/rhiza (ci-install wrote .github/workflows/rhiza.yml into main). The arbiter ruled: serve m4-runs-hold-up; move {run_tmp} out of every git repository to a per-user cache dir (os.UserCacheDir()/rhiza/run-tmp/<run id>, falling back to os.TempDir()/rhiza-run-tmp-<uid>/<run id>), still made at step start and removed at run end, with no workflow edits; and make cmd/rhiza's testscript Setup fail a script whose $WORK lies inside a git work tree or git dir, naming the path and saying to set GOTMPDIR outside the repo. Nothing left open.
fields.title: Plan: testscripts inside a run write into the real repo
